long_biography.plain_text:
Sea Pearl, a beachfront apartment tower in Mooloolaba, brought Shane Leadbetter's property business to the Sunshine Coast's esplanade. His company commissioned the scheme, while Hutchinson Builders delivered the twelve-storey project. Leadbetter had entered property after decades directing an Australian vehicle-protection manufacturer, experience that preceded the family's move into residential and industrial development.

His Queensland portfolio has included luxury houses, industrial sites and boutique apartments, with project selection and design prominent in the firm's own account of its work. The Sea Pearl site was confined by neighbouring buildings, pavements and a busy retail district, requiring close coordination with consultants and trades. The completed tower received a Queensland residential-building award.
